message: Моделируйте fallible-состояние явно вместо вызова unwrap().
negative: fn f(result: Result<(), ()>) -> Result<(), ()> { result?; Ok(()) }

message: Предпочитайте явную ошибку вместо panic(); прямой net/http.ErrAbortHandler разрешён при доказанной привязке импорта.

controls.name: default-grouped-import
named-import
named-grouped-import
explicit-http-import
mixed-lawful-and-ordinary
other-http-error
wrapped-abort
sentinel-variable
wrong-import
missing-import
blank-import
different-alias
local-shadow
controls.source:
package p
import "net/http"
var _ = http.MethodGet
func f() { http := struct { ErrAbortHandler error }{}; panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) }

controls.name: parameter-shadow
controls.source:
package p
import "net/http"
var _ = http.MethodGet
func f(http struct { ErrAbortHandler error }) { panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) }

controls.name: alias-parameter-shadow
controls.source:
package p
import web "net/http"
var _ = web.MethodGet
func f(web struct { ErrAbortHandler error }) { panic(web.ErrAbortHandler) }

controls.name: range-shadow
controls.source:
package p
import "net/http"
var _ = http.MethodGet
func f(values []struct { ErrAbortHandler error }) { for _, http := range values { panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) } }

controls.name: type-switch-shadow
controls.source:
package p
import "net/http"
var _ = http.MethodGet
func f(value any) { switch http := value.(type) { case struct { ErrAbortHandler error }: panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) } }

controls.name: named-result-shadow
controls.source:

var _ = http.MethodGet
func f() (http struct { ErrAbortHandler error }) { panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) }

controls.name: closure-shadow
controls.source:
package p

var _ = http.MethodGet
func f() { http := struct { ErrAbortHandler error }{}; func() { panic(http.ErrAbortHandler) }() }
